Invented in 1832 by 16-year-old apprentice Franz Sacher for Prince Metternich, this isn’t your standard chocolate sponge. It’s dense, deep dark chocolate cake sliced thin, coated in a tart layer of warm apricot jam, and sealed inside a crackable, glossy dark chocolate glaze. The golden rule: It is always served with a massive cloud of Schlagobers (cold, completely unsweetened whipped cream).
